_comment: Head numbers are vanilla 26.1.2 ToolMaterial constants, read from the game jar (durability, speed, attackDamageBonus, incorrectBlocksForDrops), and attack is what Items.java gives each tool of that material as [attackDamageBaseline, attackSpeedBaseline]: constant across materials for sword, pickaxe and shovel, hand tuned per material for axe and hoe, so every hoe deals 1 and a diamond axe deals 9 like an iron one; enchantment_value moved to the binding, which is where PLAN.md section 4 puts it. Handle multipliers and binding slot counts are Temper's own: the handle trades durability against swing speed, the binding trades enchantability against modifier slots, so neither part is a free upgrade. Adding a material is a new entry here and nothing else. Colours are calibrated against the vanilla item after tinting; see scripts/sword-sprite.py --calibrate.
